description:
Dual-Motor Power, Extended Range, and All-Terrain Control

The Kornorge T73 Pro Max Electric Bike is designed for riders who want stronger acceleration, longer riding range, and confident performance across demanding everyday routes. Its dual-motor system delivers up to 3000W combined peak output, with one 1500W motor at each wheel for powerful all-wheel-drive assistance and a maximum speed of up to 37.5 mph where local regulations permit.

A dual removable battery system combining 48V 20Ah and 48V 15.6Ah batteries supports up to 120 miles of pedal-assist range under ideal conditions. Full suspension, hydraulic disc brakes, 20 × 4.0 inch fat tires, and a Shimano 7-speed drivetrain provide a stable and controlled riding experience across city streets, hills, gravel paths, and other mixed surfaces.

Why Choose the Kornorge T73 Pro Max Electric Bike?

3000W Peak Dual-Motor System
Dual 1500W peak motors provide strong acceleration and all-wheel-drive assistance for hills, faster commuting, and more demanding mixed-surface riding.

Up to 37.5 mph Top Speed
The dual-motor system delivers speeds of up to 37.5 mph under suitable conditions and where local regulations permit.

Dual Removable Battery System
A 48V 20Ah battery paired with a 48V 15.6Ah battery provides extended riding capacity while allowing convenient charging and battery removal.

Up to 120 Miles of Pedal-Assist Range
The high-capacity dual-battery system supports longer commuting and recreational rides with fewer charging stops under ideal riding conditions.

Full Suspension
Dual front suspension forks and rear shock absorption help reduce road vibration and impacts for improved comfort and control across uneven surfaces.

Hydraulic Disc Brakes
Front and rear hydraulic disc brakes provide responsive and consistent stopping power for higher-speed riding, hills, and changing road conditions.

20 × 4.0 Inch All-Terrain Fat Tires
Wide fat tires provide a larger contact patch for improved traction, stability, and confidence across pavement, gravel, sand, and other mixed surfaces.

Shimano 7-Speed Drivetrain
The Shimano 7-speed drivetrain adds mechanical gearing flexibility for different speeds, gradients, and riding conditions.

Smart LCD Display & App Connectivity
Monitor speed, battery status, riding distance, assistance level, and other ride information through the detachable LCD display and compatible mobile app.

Who Is the Kornorge T73 Pro Max Electric Bike For?

Riders Seeking Maximum Power
The dual 1500W motors provide significantly stronger acceleration and climbing capability than a conventional single-motor commuter e-bike.

Long-Distance Riders
With up to 120 miles of pedal-assist range under ideal conditions, the dual-battery system is designed for riders who want greater flexibility between charges.

Hill and Mixed-Terrain Riders
All-wheel-drive assistance, fat tires, and full suspension help the T73 Pro Max maintain confident traction and control across steeper grades and changing surfaces.

High-Performance Commuters
Strong acceleration, hydraulic braking, extended battery capacity, and practical smart features make the T73 Pro Max suitable for longer and more demanding daily routes.

Comfort-Focused Riders
Full suspension, wide tires, and an extended moped-style saddle provide a stable and comfortable platform for longer everyday rides.

Motor System
Dual 1500W Peak Motors / 3000W Combined Peak Output

Battery System
Dual Removable 48V 20Ah + 48V 15.6Ah Lithium-ion Batteries

Maximum Range
Up to 120 Miles in Pedal-Assist Mode

Maximum Speed
Up to 37.5 mph, Where Local Regulations Permit

Suspension
Full Suspension — Dual Front Fork + Rear Shock

Tire Size
20 × 4.0 Inch All-Terrain Fat Tires

Spokes
12G × 131 mm Front and Rear

Net Weight
115.57 lb / 52.4 kg, Including Batteries

Maximum speed, range, climbing ability, and other performance figures are based on manufacturer specifications and testing. Actual performance may vary depending on motor mode, rider weight, assistance level, terrain, weather, temperature, tire pressure, battery condition, and riding conditions. Always follow applicable local e-bike laws and regulations.
